result.topic_en: A pencil drawing of a symmetric network of curves (apparently level curves of the argument of a complex function or polynomial, by analogy with Gauss's work on the fundamental theorem of algebra), with points along the boundary labelled by angles in steps of 45 degrees; there is no prose text.
result.transcription:
[Drawing: a figure symmetric about a horizontal axis, with lines radiating from a central point and families of curves surrounding several elongated loops; dots mark the intersections; the boundary points carry the following angle labels]

Left lobe (from tip, upper side): 45  90  135  180  225  270  315  0

Upper lobe: 45  90  135  180  225  270  315

Small spiral loop, upper right: 0  45[?]  90  135  180  225  270  315

Right lobe: 0  45  90  135  18[?]

methods.what: Graphical plot of curves along which a complex-valued function takes constant argument; boundary points are labelled by the argument in steps of 45°
